title: Browse, where a newcomer finds the neighbourhood

criteria.text: Browse is its own surface at `/explore`, own tab; not merged with Home
criteria.note: Nav tab Explore (`BottomNav.tsx`), `/` redirects to `/explore` (`src/app/page.tsx`, Home paused, #138) [V]. Checked: unmarked `BottomNav.test.tsx` ('renders exactly two tabs: Explore, You'); nothing asserts Home is not merged in (#589). Reviewed no: #138 and #308 carry no `Reviewed by:`. Shipped: deploy-health green on 3d7b5974 and 78cdefbd [V]. Smoked: smoke-live runs 39805278303 (2026-10-22, main e0bdaf15, explore and explore-map) and 39977671049 (2026-10-23, cb892a75, explore) were green at 390 and 1280 for signed-out, stranger, member, owner and operator personas; they load the route, they do not tap [V].

criteria.text: Pages and posts together, complete, nothing withheld that the reader may see
criteria.note: Built half [V]: since #881 (Don, 2026-10-16 on #796) the default view mixes Pages, posts and followed updates, with a megaphone or page icon on each card (#877) and never more than two of a category in a row (#902). Missing: completeness. The whole-area read is still capped at `BROWSE_LIMIT = 100` with no paging, Pages and posts sharing the slots (`load.ts`), and since #932 the default read is the nearest ring that holds about 24 things on this week, widened by 'Show more nearby' (Don, 2026-10-18 [for now, beta]); a shared link with `?reach=all` or a filter reads the whole area, still capped at 100 [V]. Open #828 (the cap); check in #589.

criteria.text: Signed in, also own announcements and things coming up; signed out, absent
criteria.note: #881 merges the followed Pages' feed into the default mix, flagged `followed`, and dated posts sit in the same list; the 'What's happening' rows (F091) show at the top of the posts-only Type view; signed out, `followedFeed` is never called and only withheld cards stand for posts (`load.ts`) [V]. Checked: unmarked `load.test.ts` (the loader mixes and dedupes, flags followed) (#589). Reviewed no: #204 has no `Reviewed by:`, #505 is review-skipped; #881 carries `Reviewed by: Claude`. Shipped: deploy-health green on 70190413, 79db7a89, 24891b70, 3da54545 [V]. Smoked: smoke-live runs 39805278303 (2026-10-22, main e0bdaf15, explore and explore-map) and 39977671049 (2026-10-23, cb892a75, explore) were green at 390 and 1280 for signed-out, stranger, member, owner and operator personas; they load the route, they do not tap [V].

criteria.text: Signed-in half withheld server-side, never rendered and hidden
criteria.note: `followedFeed` runs only with a `userId`; the SQL predicate on `p_following` withholds; signed out resolves no follow set (`load.ts`); a filtered read goes through `browse_feed` (#881) [V]. Reviewed no (#204 carries no `Reviewed by:`). Shipped: green on 70190413, 3da54545. Checked: unmarked `load.test.ts` ('never asks for it at all'), `load-withheld.test.ts` ('never calls the withheld path' signed in); no standing guard (#589). Smoked: smoke-live runs 39805278303 (2026-10-22, main e0bdaf15, explore and explore-map) and 39977671049 (2026-10-23, cb892a75, explore) were green at 390 and 1280 for signed-out, stranger, member, owner and operator personas; they load the route, they do not tap [V].

criteria.text: Order is locality and recency; never payment, size, follower count or what keeps you scrolling
criteria.note: `browse_feed` orders by recency inside the scope; since #932 the scope is the nearest reach ring from the member's home town (Don, 2026-10-18, locality first); `session-shuffle.ts` reshuffles only inside recency bands; `mixRuns` (#902) is an order-only pass that breaks runs of one category and moves no dated post; searching orders by text rank (#924) [V]. Hood, town and adjacency order is F104, not built (#697). No guard scans for payment, size, follower count or engagement columns (#590). Under review (2026-10-12, [for now], Find only): the 'doesn't favour a member because of payment' clause, for paid promotion on Discover. Reviewed no (#161 no line; #558, #815, #902 review-skipped; #932 reviewed). Shipped: green on 56404a51, f7782d6f, 24891b70, b7766901, 17734c4a, f8578fbb [V]. Smoked: smoke-live runs 39805278303 (2026-10-22, main e0bdaf15, explore and explore-map) and 39977671049 (2026-10-23, cb892a75, explore) were green at 390 and 1280 for signed-out, stranger, member, owner and operator personas; they load the route, they do not tap [V].

criteria.text: Curated lenses (today, local food, household, art, free, newly opened Pages), each a way to change what is discoverable
criteria.note: Built half [V]: the 'What's new since you were here' first look (#800 `lead.ts`), the 'What's happening' rows (F091, in the posts-only view), and since #881 a Category group (the 12 interest tags) and My interests (#911) inside the filter sheet, which Don's 2026-10-16 ruling made opt-in filters, not lens rows. Missing: local food, household and art as shown rows; the newcomers lens is only part of the first look and has no thin-row rule; the free lens waits on what makes a thing free (#832, needs-pm). Open #587.

criteria.text: No exhaustive kind picker; typed search stays a separate job
criteria.note: No pill or chip row on Browse: `BrowseSurface.tsx` renders the search row, the reach line and cards; search is the box, now server-side over the whole market (#924) [V]. Don's 2026-10-16 ruling on #796 put a Type group (Everything / Pages / Posts, event / deal / last-minute, Following only) and a Category group inside the F092 panel (#881); read here as the panel F092 permits, not the results-surface kind picker the 2026-09-17 ruling refused [A]. `tests/no-chips.test.ts` (#956) keeps chip and pill shapes out but does not scan for a kind picker; no guard for this clause (#590). Reviewed no (#174 has no `Reviewed by:`; #881 reviewed). Shipped: green on 9dde664f, 3da54545. Smoked: smoke-live runs 39805278303 (2026-10-22, main e0bdaf15, explore and explore-map) and 39977671049 (2026-10-23, cb892a75, explore) were green at 390 and 1280 for signed-out, stranger, member, owner and operator personas; they load the route, they do not tap [V].

criteria.text: Under 1024px a floating Map/List pill at bottom centre, visible while scrolling
criteria.note: As written, not built: #479 (Don's #328) put one expanding control at the bottom right (`ExploreDock.tsx`: search, filter, area, List/Map), and #956 made it a rounded-rectangle bar under Don's 2026-10-18 [always] no-chips rule, noting 'newer wins' over the word pill [V]. The scenario's 2026-10-01 ruling still says a pill at bottom centre; neither #328 nor the no-chips rule is a dated line in its Rulings. Routed to `scope-scenario`; nothing built or filed until it is ruled. The dock is covered by `BrowseSurface.layout.test.tsx` (#328 block) and `ExploreDock.test.tsx`, unmarked.

criteria.note: `layout === 'split'` from 1024px for a member, with the 'map-collapse-handle' button (#279); pins load after the list (#553); a Page's map opens here zoomed on that Page with a way back (#944) [V]. Reviewed no: #279 carries no `Reviewed by:`, #553 skipped; #944 reviewed. Shipped: green on 18948ae7, 238a19f5, 00832944 [V]. Checked: partial marker only (`BrowseSurface.layout.test.tsx:99`, `evals/features/F059-explore-list-and-map-by-width.spec.ts:6`) (#589). Smoked: run 39805278303 (2026-10-22) opened explore-map at 1280 as a member, green; it loads the route [V].

criteria.text: With the owner panel open at 1280-1439px the map collapses and a List | Map switch docks in the filter bar
criteria.note: Built half [V]: the docked layout exists behind `ownerPanelOpen`, which nothing sets (open question owner=cowork, 2026-10-01), and it tests 1024-1439px, not the ruled 1280-1439px; #956 restyled the docked tabs as underlined text. Missing: an owner panel on Explore. Open #831 (needs-pm: build the panel or drop the clause).

criteria.text: Signed out, Explore is list only; the Map control opens sign-up
criteria.note: `layout` is 'single' signed out at every width; the dock's Map opens `SignInPrompt` (#496, #334); `?view=map&focus=` (#944) opens the map only `initial.signedIn`; `loadMemberMap` returns no pins signed out [V]. Reviewed no (#496 review-skipped; #944 reviewed). Shipped: green on 0cee585a, 00832944. Checked: the '#334' describe in `BrowseSurface.layout.test.tsx` and the F059 eval are unmarked or partial (#589). Smoked: both runs opened explore signed out, and run 39805278303 explore-map signed out, green [V].

criteria.note: `CardGrid` renders only result cards; the reach line (#932) and the first look sit above the grid, outside the results region, and the toggle left the rows in #279 [V]. `BrowseSurface.layout.test.tsx` ('the card grid holds only cards') sits under a partial marker; no standing guard (#590). criteria.text: Results scope to the vantage's market (home market by default, a typed place for the session); nobody picks a market, none is picked from IP
criteria.note: Restated 2026-10-11 (F104, F105). Not built [V]: scope is still a metro chosen by `?metro=`, the area picker, the device cookie or the member's default, with `resolveFeedMetro` falling back to Sacramento (`feed-metro.ts`, `DEFAULT_METRO_SLUG`); no market model, no waiting-market absence. #932 added `explore_vantage(metro)`, the member's home town inside the database as where the rings start (signed out, the market's principal city), a step toward F105 but not a typed place and still inside the metro scope. Open #696 (market scoping) and #698 (place control), both `deferred` to the fortnight after beta; #588 (no-metro visitor) is answered by F105 criterion 5 and is stale.

criteria.text: The place control moves a signed-in member's results, not only a signed-out visitor's
criteria.note: Restated 2026-10-11 (F105 place control). Built half [V]: the area picker and a neighbourhood search (#479, #476) move a member's results and save the pick as their default; the reach line and the sheet's How far group (#932) move how far they reach. Missing: the place control that takes any typed town, county or market, as session state only; F105 replaces the saved default. Open #698.

criteria.text: Past-dated posts drop out on their own
criteria.note: `post_current_until` (#914, migration 20261018170000): a dated post stays until it ends (#815), an undated one for 14 days or until the owner's `show_until` (Don, 2026-10-02 on #314); `browse_feed` and `announcements_withheld` both call it [V]. Reviewed no (#161 no line, #815 review-skipped; #914 reviewed). Shipped: green on 56404a51, b7766901, 1fc06c8b [V]. Checked: unmarked `tests/migrations-browse-feed.test.ts` ('drops a past-dated post on its own, and never drops an undated one', 'keeps a post that has started and not ended') and `tests/undated-posts-expire-db.test.ts` ('Explore keeps an undated post for 14 days, or until the date its owner set') (#589). Smoked: both runs are after #914 and green on explore [V].

criteria.text: Each result carries the name its people are known by; a concealing brand label fails
criteria.note: A Page card leads with its photo and name; a post card (#931) leads with the post's first line and carries the Page's name and avatar beneath; cards show no seller (#254) and no hashtags (#748, up to two labels as small caps) [V]. Whether a label conceals ownership is a Page-content question not checked here [A]. Reviewed no (#174 no line, #748 review-skipped; #931 reviewed). Shipped: green on 9dde664f, 87daab2f, 9437cf9a, 0ebfaa1e. Checked: unmarked `BrowseResultCard.cards.test.tsx`, `BrowseResultCard.test.tsx` (#589). criteria.text: Shared link reopens same metro and search; back restores scroll
criteria.note: `?metro=`, `?area=`, `?q=` and `?reach=` round-trip (`query.ts`); the sheet's words live in the box so a link carries them (#750); #942 writes the URL with `history.replaceState`, so typing never re-renders the server and back returns to the same search; #885 keeps how deep the visitor scrolled so back renders as far; scroll is restored once per mount under the literal key `'explore'`, so a metro switch is not re-keyed (open #54) [V]. Reviewed no: the scroll hook landed by direct commit 06bc333; #942 and #885 carry `Reviewed by: Claude`. Shipped unknown: no run for 06bc333; a6d4682e and 9ac96f26 green. Checked: unmarked `query.test.ts`, `useScrollRestoration.test.ts`, `BrowseSurface.test.tsx` ('#935 typing writes the words into the URL in place'); nothing asserts metro plus search reopen together (#589).
